A '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] was conducted by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Meetra Surik]] in [[3951 BBY]], which set off a series of conflicts between the [[Onderon Royalist]]s, [[Onderon separatists]] and the [[Lost Jedi]] in an effort to find [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kavar]]. Meanwhile, several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] were [[First Jedi Purge|hunting]] Surik because of the [[Exchange]]'s [[Bounty/Legends|Bounty]] on live Jedi.
